reason: Confirmed from the cited AUS news page (published 6 November 2025) and independently from Sharjah24's republication of the WAM report (6 November 2025). Both state: first place at the Sharjah Tourism Innovation Hackathon 2025 (held 1-2 November 2025 at AUS, as part of SITTF 2025) went to team Hayyakum (Mahmoud Darwish, Amr Mohi Aldeen, Mohamad Dabbagh, Afif Zughayer) for "Sharjah Quest," a gamified tourism app in which visitors "collect digital stamps, unlock mascots and follow curated itineraries"; the team "earned AED 20,000 and will present their solution at SITTF 2025." Darwish's quoted remarks in both sources call it an "augmented reality-powered mobile adventure" with "a digital passport, heritage mascots and citywide challenges" where visitors "complete quests, earn stamps and badges and climb leaderboards across museums, souqs, heritage houses, natural sites and local small and medium-sized enterprises." The Ajman University page independently confirms the event name, dates, and organizers. Two precision notes: (1) "stage slot" is a paraphrase; the sources say only "will present their solution at SITTF 2025," and the AUS team membership is stated by the WAM/Sharjah24 line that AUS teams took the first two places. (2) The AR, quests, badges, and leaderboards wording comes from the winning team member's quote, not the article's own description, which lists only stamps, mascots, and itineraries. The second sentence of the claim (overlap with "their draft" covering AR guide, route planning, and gamification rather than only a treasure hunt) is not a checkable public fact: the project folder D:\Sharjah Tourism Hackathon holds only the 2026 event brief and an AI disclosure template, which mention an AI guide and an AR view but contain no draft, and no file mentions treasure hunt, route planning, or gamification. That part is unverified rather than refuted.
corrected_claim: The Sharjah Tourism Innovation Hackathon 2025 (1-2 November 2025, AUS, held as part of SITTF 2025) was won by team Hayyakum (Mahmoud Darwish, Amr Mohi Aldeen, Mohamad Dabbagh, Afif Zughayer, an AUS team) with "Sharjah Quest," a gamified tourism app through which visitors collect digital stamps, unlock mascots, and follow curated itineraries to local sites and businesses; the team earned AED 20,000 and, per the article, "will present their solution at SITTF 2025." According to team member Darwish's quoted remarks, it is an augmented reality-powered mobile adventure with a digital passport, heritage mascots, and citywide challenges in which visitors complete quests, earn stamps and badges, and climb leaderboards across museums, souqs, heritage houses, natural sites, and local SMEs. Source: https://www.aus.edu/media/news/sharjah-tourism-innovation-hackathon-at-aus-reimagines-travel-and-tourism-experience ; independent confirmation: https://sharjah24.ae/en/Articles/2025/11/06/Innovation-Hackathon-reimagines-tourism-experience-at-AUS . The statement about overlap with the team's own draft (AR guide, route planning, gamification versus treasure hunt) is an internal comparison that cannot be confirmed from any public source or from the files in D:\Sharjah Tourism Hackathon.
